ios.desc:
A PLACE TO BRIDGE THE GAP AND MEET NOW

Discover a new way to build your network with Bridgit Social. Whether you're seeking professional opportunities, local community events, or meaningful social connections, Bridgit helps you find the right people at the right time.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set Your Intentions: Tell the community exactly what you’re looking for today.
2. Craft Your Pitch: Use our AI-assistant to generate the perfect professional or social introduction.
3. Discover Nearby: Check the interactive map or real-time feed for active users in your vicinity.
4. Bridge the Gap: Match, chat instantly, and meet up in person at Bridgit Executive venues, at partner venues, local "Bridges" or at a place of your choice.

TRY BRIDGIT FOR FREE 
• Skim through the app as a guest to explore your local network and see real-time activity nearby before you even sign up!

KEY FEATURES

SMART MATCHING: 
• Connect with individuals nearby based on shared professional or social intentions.

AI PITCH ASSISTANT 
• Never struggle with an introduction again. Our AI analyzes your profile and intentions to suggest personalized, high-impact pitches. Save different versions for different contexts.

INSTANT CHAT & CONNECTIONS 
• Connect with purpose. Once you match, jump into our secure chat to coordinate your meeting and build authentic relationships.

INTERACTIVE COMMUNITY FEED 
• Share what's happening, what's in your mind, your pitch, discover what others are looking for, and engage with your local community and see who's ready to meet right now.

LOCAL MAP DISCOVERY 
• See real-time networking activity and discover "Same Place" or "Nearby" opportunities. View full professional profiles, check target intentions, and send connection requests instantly as you move through your city.

REAL-TIME BRIDGES & VENUES 
• Don't just network anywhere. Join "Bridges"—special networking zones created by users—or check into Bridgit Exclusive partner venues to meet verified professionals in a curated environment.

SAFE & MODERATED: 
• Built-in AI moderation and reporting systems ensure a premium, safe environment for everyone.
• Secure authentication (Apple, Google, LinkedIn). 
• Granular privacy controls: You decide when you're visible and who sees your location.

UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE: 
BRIDGIT PREMIUM 
Everything in Standard, PLUS: 
• See Who Marked You: View who’s interested in meeting before you decide to match. 
• Unlimited Networking Requests: Connect without boundaries or daily limi

quotes.text:
I recently launched Bridgit Social, an iOS app that helps people discover and connect with others who are physically nearby — either in the same place or within walking distance, to meet in-person, HERE and NOW!

The goal is to make meeting new people feel simple, immediate, and grounded in real-world presence — not through long online exchanges.

This project started from a personal need to expand both my personal and professional networks. I had used various social networking apps and grew frustrated that most of them led to long online conversations, but rarely resulted in real-life interactions — where the actual human connection actually begins!

I wanted something built specifically to support in-person connections, while respecting privacy and giving users full control. You can think of it as a way to bring some of the value of LinkedIn into real-world, in-the-moment interactions.

Links:
- Landing page: https://bridgitsocial.com
- App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bridgit-social/id6743941115
